records.title: Next-gen Acura RDX (2028 release) previewed based on Hybrid SUV & Nexera Concepts
records.excerpt: The Acura RDX is back in 2028 featuring a hybrid powertrain for the first time. It will also be the first Acura to use Honda’s two-motor hybrid system. Next-gen Acura RDX (2028 release) previewed based on Hybrid SUV & Nexera Concepts Last Updated On: November 22, 2026 1:16 PM . Original article by: Shrawan Raja Acura will bring the RDX back in 2028 with the first hybrid powertrain in the compact SUV’s 20-year history . The fourth-gen model will also be the first Acura to use Honda’s two-motor hybrid system, giving the brand a direct rival to the Lexus NX 350h, which received updates for the 2027 model year. Our exclusive renderings are based on the Acura Hybrid SUV Prototype that Honda unveiled in May 2026. Here’s what the prototype tells us about the next-gen RDX and what we expect from the production SUV. Design Split headlights and a low-set grille clearly differentiate the identity of the next-gen RDX Hybrid (rendered). The biggest change up front is the position of the grille. On the outgoing RDX, the Diamond Pentagon grille fills the space between the headlights. The 2028 Acura RDX moves the main air intake lower in the bumper, leaving a body-color panel around the Acura emblem. Slim daytime running lights sit just below the hood, with the main lamps in separate housings farther down. In profile, the prototype keeps a long roof over the rear seats. The lower window line kicks up behind the rear doors, and a sharply angled rear pillar gives the SUV a narrower side window at the back. A roof spoiler extends over the sloping rear glass. The RDX Hybrid will be its first production model with the lighting signature previewed on the NEXERA Vision. Image Source: Acura (Acura Hybrid SUV Concept shown). Kelley Blue Book reported in August 2026 that Acura identified the unbadged, exterior-only model as the next RDX in materials for a July media preview. The publication quoted Ben Davidson, exterior design lead for the Acura Nexera Vision, as saying that the lighting was the clearest link between the sports coupe concept and the SUV. At the rear, the slim taillights follow the angle of Acura’s “A” emblem. Interior In an August 2026 interview with The Drive , Acura creative director Yasutake Tsuchida said the Nexera Vision also previewed the brand’s approach to interiors and some of the materials it plans to use. We expect the most noticeable change for drivers to be the center console. The outgoing RDX uses a touchpad beside the shifter to operate its 10.2-inch display. A touchscreen within the driver’s reach would free up that space for storage or a charging pad. Expect a low dashboard with a freestanding touchscreen in the next-gen RDX, with inspiration derived from the Nexera Vision (pictured). Equipment We expect the next-gen Acura RDX to feature a new digital instrument cluster and infotainment touchscreen, each with an updated interface. The infotainment system should offer Google built-in, wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, and a Wi-Fi hotspot. Other cabin upgrades could include a higher-output wireless charging pad with built-in cooling, memory settings for both front seats, and an upgraded audio system. Next-gen ADAS Honda plans to introduce its next-generation driver-assistance system in 2028 and roll it out across more than 15 models over five years. The revised AcuraWatch system is designed to help drivers steer and accelerate along a route entered into the navigation system, on both highways and local streets. Acura has yet to confirm whether the RDX Hybrid will offer it at launch, but we expect the compact SUV to receive the tech in due course. Specifications We expect the RDX Hybrid to ride on Honda’s new midsize platform, which debuted in the three-row Avancier in November 2026, and will also underpin the next-gen Honda CR-V , Accord, and Civic . The architecture uses five modules, allowing sedans and SUVs to share the engine compartment and rear underbody while giving designers room to tailor the rear cabin to each model. We expect the new RDX’s fuel economy (EPA, combined) to reach up to around 40 mpg, with 230-250 hp on tap. Honda says the platform weighs about 198 pounds (90 kg) less than its previous hybrid platform. On earlier Honda SUVs, the hybrid battery occupied the well beneath the cargo floor. Honda now packages the battery under the second-row seats. The battery cover bolts to the seat rails and helps stiffen the body. In Honda’s midsize hybrid system, the 2.0-liter four-cylinder engine can turn a generator while a separate electric motor drives the front wheels. At highway cruising speeds, the engine can drive the wheels directly. The Avancier also uses a separate rear motor for all-wheel drive. The 50 kW class rear motor should be a big selling point for the new RDX in North America, particularly in the snowbelt states. Price & Release Date We expect the next-gen RDX Hybrid (rendered) to begin at under USD 50,000, competing with the Mercedes GLC , BMW X3 , and the Audi Q5 . Design elements previewed by NEXERA Vision will influence future Acura production models, beginning with the next-generation RDX Hybrid coming to market in 2028. From Acura’s announcement for the LA Auto Show on November 16, 2026 We estimate a U.S. starting price of around USD 48,000 before destination. For reference, the 2026 gas model starts at USD 45,100 in the U.S. and around CAD 55,000 in Canada before freight. records.excerpt: 810,592 Honda and Acura Vehicles Recalled Over Takata-Produced Airbag Inflators - autoevolution autoevolution News Cars Database Driven Moto Database Game reviews EV/Hybrids Spyshots Space Junk Renderings Your Feed Compare Cars BAC Calculator Editorial Coverstory Motorsport Testdrives archive Auto Shows Tuning Car Finder Photo of the Day Glossary of automotive terms About us Team RSS Feeds Newsletter OS Default Light Dark EICMA 2026 • Honda Has a Taste of the e-MTB World with the RN0 Motor-Assisted Bicycle • #Honda Civic 810,592 Honda and Acura Vehicles Recalled Over Takata-Produced Airbag Inflators The Japanese automaker found signs of airbag inflator propellant degradation back in 2025, yet all tested inflators remained within operating parameters Published: 21 Nov 2026, 16:24 UTC By: Mircea Panait 55 photos Photo: Honda Toyota Motor North America recently announced that it's recalling 314,029 vehicles in the United States of America, namely older cars, sport utility vehicles, and trucks equipped with PSAN airbag inflators produced by Takata. Said campaign has an American Honda Motor counterpart now, and it's a big one. Per the recall documentation published by the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration , a whopping 810,592 vehicles from the Honda and Acura brands are being recalled stateside. The population includes models fitted with Takata airbag inflators that contain moisture-absorbing material. In a similar fashion to the Toyota recall , this one boils down to long-term propellant degradation. The propellant can go bad when exposed to elevated temperatures, high humidity, and repeated temperature changes. In this context, degradation means the phase-stabilized ammonium nitrate propellant can burn abnormally when the airbag deploys, creating excessive pressure in the inflator housing. This, in turn, sends very sharp metal fragments through the airbag's cushion into the cabin. "That can't happen to me," is what many would say, but do remember that iffy Takata inflators have taken the lives of more than 35 people worldwide. In the US, the NHTSA Takata Recall Spotlight cites 28 confirmed fatalities and more than 400 injuries nationwide since 2009. So yes, those inflators are really dangerous. American Honda Motor's documentation confirms that affected inflators feature PSAN propellant and something called 13X, namely a desiccant intended to control moisture within the inflator. Despite the presence of 13X, the propellant may not perform as intended over time, fracturing more than intended. This increases the burning surface area, resulting in a higher rate of gas generation. Photo: Honda American Honda Motor is recalling the 2012 through 2013 model year CR-V and Civic, 2013 Accord, 2013 Acura RDX, and the 2013 ILX. The recall population is restricted to vehicles that AHM dealers originally sold or customers registered in 14 states and territories with high temperatures and elevated humidity. California, Louisiana, Texas, Mississippi, and Georgia are some of them. The rest are South Carolina, Alabama, Florida, Puerto Rico, Hawaii, Guam, the Northern Mariana Islands, American Samoa, and the US Virgin Islands. As you'd expect, the Civic accounts for the bulk of the recall population. Honda's compact is listed with 413,125 potentially affected cars, while the CR-V and Accord populations are estimated at 197,045 and 165,225 vehicles. Acura contributes 20,554 examples of the RDX and 14,643 of the ILX, amounting to a grand total of 810,592 automobiles. American Honda Motor has received no reports of injuries (or worse) associated with these inflators, making this a preventive recall based on degradation analysis. The investigation stretches back to June 2020 and an analysis of desiccated PSAN inflators. AHM found no signs of deterioration at that point, yet its statistical modeling indicated that propellant deterioration would advance far enough to create an inflator rupture risk before 2027 at the earliest. The investigation continued through November 2026, with AHM confirming that the inflators still operated within normal parameters. Out of an abundance of caution, both the front driver- and passenger-side inflators will be replaced free of charge with new units from a different supplier, complete with a different propellant chemistry that avoids long-term degradation problems under similar conditions. Interim notification letters will be mailed on December 18, 2026. Another notification will follow once sufficient parts become available. Liked the article? Honda and Toyota are recalling 1.6 million vehicles over the risk of Takata airbag inflators rupturing: 810,592 Honda vehicles in the US and 790,000 Toyota vehicles worldwide. Honda and Toyota are recalling a combined 1.6 million vehicles globally due to the risk of Takata airbag inflators rupturing. The recall affects approximately 810,000 older Honda models in the US and 790,000 Toyota and Lexus models worldwide. Honda's recall specifically targets vehicles in 14 US states and territories with high heat and humidity, which can accelerate inflator deterioration. Japanese carmakers Honda Motor and Toyota Motor are recalling approximately 1.6 million vehicles amid concerns that Takata airbag inflators could rupture, potentially causing serious injuries to drivers and passengers. The companies confirmed the recalls on Friday (November 20). The recalls cover cars, pick-up trucks and SUVs in the United States and other markets worldwide. Honda's recall affects 810,592 older vehicles in the US, while Toyota is recalling approximately 790,000 vehicles globally, including 314,000 in the US. Toyota and Honda models affected by recalls Toyota's recall covers several Lexus and Toyota models, including the Lexus SC430 (2002–2010), IS250 (2011) and GX460 (2017), along with the Toyota Corolla (2003–2008), Tundra (2005–2006), Sequoia (2005–2007) and 4Runner (2016–2017). Meanwhile, Honda's recall includes certain Honda Accord (2013), Civic (2012–2013) and CR-V (2012–2013) models, as well as the Acura ILX (2013) and RDX (2013). Honda recall targets hot and humid regions The Honda recall applies specifically to vehicles originally sold or registered in 14 US states and territories known for high temperatures, humidity and significant temperature fluctuations. These locations are Alabama, California, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Louisiana, Mississippi, South Carolina, Texas, Puerto Rico, the US Virgin Islands, the Northern Mariana Islands (including Saipan), Guam and American Samoa. Related Toyota to launch small truck in the US in the second half of 2027 November 11, 2026 Toyota’s half-year net profit rises 26.1% as retail vehicle sales fall November 05, 2026 BOI backs Toyota’s THB1.49bn hydrogen Hilux production October 19, 2026 No crashes or injuries linked to latest recalls Toyota has not specified which US states are covered by its recall. Replacement airbag inflators are expected to become available in early 2027. Both manufacturers have confirmed that no crashes, injuries or airbag inflator ruptures have been reported involving the vehicles covered by the latest recalls. Nevertheless, they will replace the affected inflators as a precaution. Takata airbag defects linked to 28 deaths in US According to Reuters, defective Takata airbag inflators have been linked to at least 28 deaths and more than 400 injuries in the US since 2009, triggering the largest automotive safety recall in US history. All the reported fatalities involved inflators that lacked a desiccant, a moisture-absorbing agent. At least 20 of those deaths occurred in Honda vehicles. Unlike the millions of vehicles recalled previously, those covered by the latest Honda and Toyota recalls are equipped with airbag inflators containing moisture-absorbing material. US safety regulator highlights inflator deterioration risks The US National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) explained that independent testing and predictive modelling of inflator deterioration had enabled manufacturers to identify potential risks and take preventive action. In a statement issued late on Friday, the agency confirmed that Honda and Toyota had identified early signs of possible airbag inflator deterioration in certain vehicles and were conducting proactive recalls. The regulator added that other carmakers were continuing to analyse and test their airbag inflators to assess potential safety concerns. Takata airbag recalls exceed 100 million vehicles worldwide Over the past decade, more than two dozen major automotive manufacturers have recalled more than 100 million vehicles equipped with Takata airbag inflators worldwide, including approximately 67 million in the US. The long-running safety crisis has prompted widespread recalls after defective inflators were found to be capable of rupturing during airbag deployment, sending sharp metal fragments into vehicle cabins. records.excerpt: Honda Is Recalling the S2000 Roadster for Fuel Flange Joint Leak Risk - autoevolution autoevolution News Cars Database Driven Moto Database Game reviews EV/Hybrids Spyshots Space Junk Renderings Your Feed Compare Cars BAC Calculator Editorial Coverstory Motorsport Testdrives archive Auto Shows Tuning Car Finder Photo of the Day Glossary of automotive terms About us Team RSS Feeds Newsletter OS Default Light Dark EICMA 2026 • Benelli Showed the World Its New Tornado Naked Tre 903 Concept at EICMA 2026 and It's a Triple! • #Honda S2000 Honda Is Recalling the S2000 Roadster for Fuel Flange Joint Leak Risk An estimated 16,387 vehicles may have been fitted with fuel flange joint assemblies missing the required brazing material at the connection Published: 20 Nov 2026, 18:38 UTC By: Mircea Panait 7 photos Photo: Honda / edited Honda has identified a rather worrying issue affecting one of the company's most celebrated production models. According to American Honda Motor, an estimated 16,387 examples of the S2K may feature replacement fuel flange joints without the brazing material designed to secure the joint-to-flange connection. AHM claims the subject parts could loosen due to vibration, separate completely, allowing dinosaur juice to escape. This could either starve the engine of gasoline, bringing the two-seat roadster to an unexpected stop. Warnings include fuel odor and leakage, reduced acceleration response, misfiring, stalling, and the failure to restart. Sanoh Industrial is the supplier of the subject component. Part number 16623-PCX-003 is also listed in the recall documentation, where American Honda Motor explains that a customer in Japan prompted the Japanese automaker to investigate. Said customer experienced symptoms in November 2025. Two months later, a used vehicle was sourced for testing. The Japanese automaker conducted tests and analyzed the concern through May 2026. A brazing identification method for potentially affected components was developed in July 2026. Between August and October, the company investigated the potentially affected S2000 population, including cars potentially repaired with the defective assembly. Thankfully for everyone, American Honda Motor has not received any warranty claims or field reports potentially related to the described concern. Referred to as 26V749 by the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration, this recall involves 2004 and 2005 models. Photo: Honda That means all suspect vehicles are AP2s, namely the S2000 with the larger-displacement engine that is better in terms of low- and mid-range torque. The 2.2-liter mill doesn't rev as high as the 2.0-liter screamer of the AP1, but nevertheless, the AP2 prides itself on shorter lower gears, a taller sixth, carbon-fiber synchros, revised suspension, and larger wheels. Honda further worked its magic in terms of styling, updating both the front and rear bumpers, the headlights, taillights, and exhaust finishers. Objectively, the AP2 is the better all-around package while the AP1 is the more intense, purer sports car. Also worth noting, the subject 2004 and 2005 models are AP2s with a traditional cable throttle and no traction control. Starting with model year 2026, the US-market S2K switched to an electronic throttle control system that still uses a cable to connect the loud pedal to the sensor. Vehicle Stability Assist, meanwhile, combines stability and traction control. As you'd expect from such a magnificent sports car, VSA can be turned off. Honda ultimately identified 67 replacement parts that its supplier manufactured without the required brazing operation, specifically the process where two or more metal components are joined by melting a filler metal into the joint. Said material reinforces the joint-to-flange connection, but due to the potential lack of material, the press-fit connection is vulnerable to loosening and separation. Subject vehicles were produced between April 14, 2003, and September 21, 2005. The S2000 was produced at the Takanezawa and Suzuka plants through August 2009, with Suzuka taking over from Takanezawa in May 2004. Just under 110,700 units were produced in total, and over half were sent to the US market. Per the Part 573 safety recall report, owners will be notified in January 2027. Liked the article? records.title: Honda Australia could launch its first ute, based on the Mitsubishi Triton
records.excerpt: Honda Australia won't confirm or deny any plans to enter the ute market in Australia, despite a Triton-based pickup heading to Asia in 2028. Honda's local boss remains tight-lipped on any potential foray into Australia's burgeoning dual-cab ute market, saying any confirmation "won't be until much further down the line". Speaking with CarExpert at the reveal of the all-new Avancier SUV , Honda Australia's CEO, Jay Joseph, said it's so early in the piece that no markets have been confirmed to receive Honda and Mitsubishi's upcoming ute as yet. "We won't speak to specific markets for that for quite some time," Mr Joseph said. "I don't think any markets have been announced for that at this stage, and won't be until much further down the line." In October , Honda Motor Co and Mitsubishi Motors Corporation confirmed they had signed a memorandum of understanding (MOU) for the development of a new Mitsubishi Triton -based model for the Honda brand. According to the media release, Honda's new dual-cab ute is scheduled to go on sale in the ASEAN region (Association of Southeast Asian Nations) in 2028. ASEAN includes Indonesia, Malaysia, Philippines, Singapore, and Thailand. It fills a gap in Honda's Asian lineup, given its current Ridgeline pickup is produced in North America, for North America. It's also a unibody pickup, as opposed to the Triton's more traditional body-on-frame construction. Given the 18-24 month timeframe to get this new ute to market, it's believed Honda's Triton-based pickup will be in similar vein to Nissan's current D27 Navara for markets like Australia and New Zealand, which is a badge-engineered Triton. It may be the first time Honda and Mitsubishi have shared models, but it's not the first time Honda has rebadged vehicles – particularly ladder-frame ones – from other automakers. The Japanese brand has sold lightly rebadged versions of the first-generation Land Rover Discovery , as well as the Isuzu Rodeo, Trooper and TF in the 1990s. Honda's collaboration with Mitsubishi may not end with the Triton, either. The MOU states that Honda, Mitsubishi and Nissan – which currently owns around a quarter of Mitsubishi – "will continue to deepen their strategic partnership to further strengthen their competitiveness and ability to meet diverse customer needs while fully utilising their respective products and technological assets". The rumour mill suggests Honda could be looking to Nissan for models for the North American market, including a rebadged Nissan Frontier pickup truck to join the current Ridgeline. Mitsubishi has already confirmed it will soon launch a rebadged Frontier. MORE: Honda to enter ute market with rebadged Mitsubishi Triton MORE: Explore the Honda showroom

records.excerpt: Toyota and Honda issue urgent vehicle recall - 1.6 million cars affected Luke Chillingsworth Updated Sun, November 22, 2026 at 1:01 PM UTC 0 Toyota has issued a recall for models including the Corolla (Image: Getty) Toyota and Honda have issued a recall for millions of cars over safety fears in a major blow to consumers. The recall covers 790,000 Toyota vehicles across the world, including 314,000 based in the United States. Lexus, the luxury division of Toyota, has also reported some issues with over 7,000 cars affected in Australia. Cars affected include a range of top models, including the 2002-2010 Lexus SC430 and 2011 IS250. The 2017 GX460, 2003-2008 Toyota Corolla, 2005-2006 Tundra, 2005-2007 Sequoia and 2016-2017 4Runner models are also impacted. Meanwhile, the latest recall covers some 2013 Honda Accord, 2012-2013 Honda Civic, 2012-2013 Honda CR-V, 2013 Acura ILX and 2013 Acura RDX models. Honda's recall covers 810,592 older Honda cars and SUVs in the United States, with cars based in 14 states impacted. The states are in territories known for high temperatures and humidity, covering Alabama, California, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Louisiana, Mississippi, South Carolina, Texas, Puerto Rico, the U.S. Virgin Islands, the Northern Mariana Islands (Saipan), Guam and American Samoa. Both recalls are around suspected issues with Takata airbag inflators , with fears the tool could rupture in a safety risk. The United States' National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) explained they used inflator degradation simulation models to identify possible risks ahead of time. Over the past 10 years, dozens of major car companies have recalled millions of vehicles around concerns with Takata airbag inflators. Honda is recalling thousands of cars in the United States (Image: Getty) NHTSA added: "Honda and Toyota saw early evidence of degradation risk in certain of their vehicles and are currently conducting proactive recalls of vehicles." Toyota has launched an online Takata recall checker tool, with owners able to quickly determine if their vehicle is part of any outstanding Takata airbag recall campaign. Road users can then contact a local dealer to arrange a replacement completely free of charge. Honda also has an online recall checker tool, with road users asked to input their Vehicle Identification Number (VIN) to bring up details. records.excerpt: アステモ、新社長にホンダ四輪本部長の井上勝史氏 竹内弘平社長は退任 ホンダ四輪事業の立て直しを全面支援 – 日刊自動車新聞 2026.11.23(月) 管理者 紙面で読む 会社案内 各種申し込み 購読のご案内 ログイン 購読の ご案内 管理者 紙面で 読む ログイン 検索 トップ 自動車流通 開発・生産 行政・輸送 Home 自動車部品・素材・サプライヤー お知らせ アーカイブ検索サイトメンテナンス終了のお知らせ アステモ、新社長にホンダ四輪本部長の井上勝史氏 竹内弘平社長は退任 ホンダ四輪事業の立て直しを全面支援 自動車部品・素材・サプライヤー , 自動車メーカー , 人事・組織改正 2026年5月29日 11:30 SNSで共有: 井上勝史氏 ホンダと日立が出資する自動車部品メーカーのアステモ（東京都千代田区）は5月29日、ホンダの井上勝史取締役が7月1日付で社長CEO（最高経営責任者）に就任するトップ人事を内定したと発表した。竹内弘平社長CEOは退任する。6月25日の定時株主総会と7月1日の臨時取締役会を経て正式決定する。 井上氏はホンダの欧州や中国の責任者などを経て、電動事業開発部門のトップ、昨年4月には四輪事業本部長に就いたが、6月にホンダの取締役退任が決まっていた。 ホンダは日立が保有するアステモの株式21％分を取得し、出資比率を61％に引き上げて子会社化する予定でいる。電気自動車（EV）戦略の失敗で業績が悪化している同社は、ソフトウエア・デファインド・ビークル（SDV）やハイブリッド車（HV）に重点を置く方針に軌道修正した。アステモはSDVや電動車向けを含むパワートレイン技術に強い。ホンダはアステモの先進技術や開発力を高く評価しており、連携を強化する。 今回、ホンダの四輪事業部門で実務経験の長い井上氏にトップ交代することで、ホンダの四輪事業の立て直しについて、系列サプライヤーとして全面的に支える体制を整える。 竹内社長もホンダ出身で、2023年7月にアステモの社長に就いた。ホンダでは財務・管理部門が長く、アステモでは前任社長時代の品質問題を踏まえた対応や財務体質の改善、株式公開に向けた準備などを担ってきた。 井上勝史氏（いのうえ・かつし）1986年3月、横浜国立大学経営学部卒、同年4月ホンダ入社。2015年ホンダカーズインディア社長、16年ホンダ執行役員、欧州地域本部長、20年常務執行役員兼中国本部長兼本田技研工業（中国）投資総経理兼本田技研科技（中国）総経理、23年執行役専務兼電動事業開発本部長、25年取締役執行役専務兼四輪事業本部長兼リスクマネジメントオフィサー、25年6月同取締役執行役専務、26年4月同取締役。1963年10月22日生まれ、62歳。福岡県出身。 〈2026/5/29更新〉 SNSで共有: 関連記事 ホンダ、現実路線で四輪事業の収益改善へ 開発費・期間・工数を半減 「開発スピードは世界トップレベルに」 2026年5月15日 05:00 ｜ 自動車メーカー , 企画・解説・オピニオン ホンダ、電動化戦略を見直し EV目標は撤回 2029年度までに次世代HV15モデル投入 新型セダンとアキュラSUVも公開 2026年5月14日 14:10 ｜ 自動車メーカー ホンダ、アステモを子会社化 ソフトやAI開発加速 新規株式公開も視野 2025年12月18日 05:00 ｜ 自動車メーカー , 自動車部品・素材・サプライヤー ホンダ系サプライヤー、EV戦略見直しに「補償求める」「量産前の決断歓迎」などの声 2026年3月13日 05:00 ｜ 自動車部品・素材・サプライヤー 資本再編進む自動車サプライヤー 親子上場の解消 円安で外資も意欲 経営資源集中でEVやSDVに対応 2026年1月1日 05:00 ｜ 企画・解説・オピニオン , 自動車部品・素材・サプライヤー トヨタ、FCトラックベースの地震体験車を公開 災害時の給電車としても 全国自治体に導入見通し 2026年11月21日 05:00 ｜ 自動車メーカー アクセスランキング 直近 昨日 一週間 ランキングを読み込み中です。 ランキングを読み込み中です。 ランキングを読み込み中です。 ワンソクTubeのブログはこちら 【レクサス大丈夫か?!】2026年上半期の新車販売台数ランキングTOP50で異変! 意外な車が上位へ?! レクサスを叱咤激励するオーナーたちの意外な本音とは?! records.excerpt: 高田气囊已致28名美国人死亡！本田丰田再因气囊召回160万辆汽车--快科技--科技改变未来 手机版 安卓版 苹果端 博客版 登录 注册 作者私密文章，无浏览权限 返回 因版权限制，过往内容只提供给老鸟级别及以上用户访问 登录 因版权限制，过往内容只提供给老鸟级别及以上用户访问 返回 当前位置： 首页 > 资讯中心 > 爱车一族 > 传统汽车 > 文章详情 正文内容 评论（ 0 ） 高田气囊已致28名美国人死亡！本田丰田再因气囊召回160万辆汽车 2026-11-23 15:49:14 出处：快科技 作者： 若风 编辑：若风 评论 ( 0 ) 复制 纠错 # 本田 # 丰田 0 0 QQ好友 微博 微信好友 QQ空间 复制链接 0 0 关闭 AI摘要 内容由AI生成，仅供参考 快科技11月23日消息，据路透社报道，本田和丰田于11月20日宣布， 将在全球范围内召回约160万辆轿车、卡车和SUV，原因是车辆搭载的高田气囊气体发生器存在破裂风险。 其中，本田在美国召回810592辆，丰田在全球召回79万辆（美国市场占31.4万辆）， 两家车企均表示，相关车辆尚未发生人员伤亡、事故或发生器破裂事件，此次属于主动预防性召回。 具体来看，本田召回涉及部分2013款雅阁、2012至2013款思域、2012至2013款CR-V、2013款讴歌ILX和2013款讴歌RDX，覆盖美国14个高温、高湿且温差波动较大的州及属地，包括加利福尼亚、得克萨斯、佛罗里达、夏威夷、波多黎各、关岛等。 丰田召回涉及2002至2010款雷克萨斯SC430、2011款IS250、2017款GX460、2003至2008款卡罗拉、2005至2006款Tundra、2005至2007款Sequoia和2016至2017款4Runner，丰田预计替换用的气体发生器要到2027年初才能备齐。 与以往不同的是， 此次召回车辆的气囊气体发生器内含吸湿干燥剂，这类产品此前被认为相对安全，并未列入召回范围。 美国国家公路交通安全管理局（NHTSA）表示，独立测试机构的分析和发生器劣化模拟模型让车企得以在风险显现前行动，“本田和丰田在部分车辆中发现了劣化风险的早期证据，正在实施主动召回”，其他车企也在继续进行发生器分析和测试。 本田称，长期监测发现特定地理区域内部分发生器存在潜在推进剂劣化，丰田则警告，劣化的推进剂可能导致气囊展开时发生器破裂并造成严重伤害。 据悉，高田气囊缺陷已酿成美国汽车史上最大规模召回。 自2009年以来，美国已有至少28人因此死亡、超过400人受伤，所有死亡案例均涉及不含干燥剂的发生器，其中至少20起发生在本田车上。 过去十年，全球二十多家车企累计召回超过1亿辆搭载高田气囊发生器的汽车，仅美国就达约6700万辆。 【本文结束】如需转载请务必注明出处：快科技 责任编辑：若风 文章内容举报 相关资讯 本田把四缸摩托车交给中国生产：不仅在国内卖 还要出口欧洲 新一代本田冠道发布：新增三排成七座、中国特供变全球 丰田被拉下马！巴西人最想买的车是比亚迪 美国人嫌皮卡太大 让丰田听见了：推出迷你皮卡KEI-01 被自动启停功能坑了 美国NHTSA调查超100万辆本田汽车 支持打赏 支持 0 人 反对 打赏 文章价值打分 当前文章打分 0 分，共有 0 人打分 0 0 0 打赏 | 分享好友: 分享至QQ 分享至微博 分享至QQ空间 | 生成海报 保存图片 QQ好友 微博 微信好友 QQ空间 给作者大大一些小奖励 本文收录在 # 本田 # 丰田 # 高田气囊 热门文章 换一波 好物推荐 换一波 关注我们 微博： 快科技官方 快科技官方微博 今日头条： 快科技 带来硬件软件、手机数码最快资讯！ 抖音： kkjcn 科技快讯、手机开箱、产品体验、应用推荐... 关于我们 关于我们 隐私权说明 交流合作 加入我们 意见反馈 广告刊例 关注我们 微信公众号： 微博号： 快科技官方 QQ群：53467377 安卓客户端下载 IOS客户端下载 快科技·1997-2025 版权所有 Copyright(C)Mydrivers.com, All Rights Reserved. 豫ICP备2023031922号-1 豫公网安备 41010502003949号 热点推荐 好物推荐 APP下载 手机扫码下载 支持Android/iOS/iPad 投稿 纠错 线索爆料 爆料群 爆料1群 打开微信扫一扫 扫描入群，加入爆料 意见反馈 评论 返回顶部 ﻿ 100 % 图片信息 图片描述: 图片格式： 图片尺寸： 上传时间： < %Response.Write("ZZMARK14098")%>

records.excerpt: 本田把81万辆含干燥剂Takata气囊纳入召回：这次关键是车辆“去过哪里” 首页 栏目 最新 电动化 智能化 联网化 共享化 设计 营与销 后市场 零部件 经销商 主机厂 专栏 视频 直播 大奖 轩辕奖 金轩奖 峰会 中国汽车蓝皮书论坛 公众号 当前位置： 栏目 > 最新 > 文章详情 本田把81万辆含干燥剂Takata气囊纳入召回：这次关键是车辆“去过哪里” 来源：汽车商业评论（summer）2026-11-21 17:38 美国本田将810592辆Honda与Acura纳入新的Takata气囊召回。与早期“不含干燥剂”的高风险气体发生器不同，这一批零件带有吸湿材料；长期监测仍发现，特定高温、高湿和温差环境下推进剂可能劣化。 召回覆盖部分2012—2013款Civic和CR-V、2013款Accord，以及2013款Acura ILX和RDX。是否命中不只看当前所在地，还要看车辆是否曾在指定州和美国属地销售或登记，因此二手车跨州流转尤其需要用VIN核对。 本次召回车型资料图；是否涉及取决于VIN与登记历史。 摄影/来源：Bull-Doser at English Wikipedia；许可： Public domain ； 授权页 。 含干燥剂并不意味着风险为零 问题机制仍是长期环境暴露后推进剂性能变化，充气时气体发生器可能破裂并向车厢喷射金属碎片。维修方案是免费更换驾驶员或乘客侧前排气囊气体发生器，具体位置取决于车辆配置。 本次召回车型资料图；照片不证明装有问题气囊。 摄影/来源：IFCAR；许可： Public domain ； 授权页 。 Cars.com 和Reuters均独立确认81.06万辆规模；NHTSA的Takata专题提供VIN查询。车主不应仅凭车型名单自行拆卸气囊，也不应因为车辆现在居住在干燥地区就排除历史暴露。 资料来源：American Honda；NHTSA；Cars.com；Reuters。 上一页 下一页 重点推荐 奔驰锁定海德鲁低碳铝：供应协议从2026年延续至2030年以后 极狐AI轿跑阿尔法S5 2027款上市 限时补贴价 11.58万元起 福特Super Duty落地奥克维尔：近50亿加元改造背后，政府资金买到什么 聚焦五大能力，李尔中国发布未来战略及研发新布局 日产把菠萝叶织进车身面板：纤维强度是起点，吸水与量产才是门槛

records.title: 1.75万元起，五羊本田NWZ150正式发布，旗舰车型就是不一样！
records.excerpt: 1.75万元起，五羊本田NWZ150正式发布，旗舰车型就是不一样！_车家号_汽车之家 文章详情 去App查看 1.75万元起，五羊本田NWZ150正式发布，旗舰车型就是不一样！ 骑士分享 优质 · 关注 五羊本田的150踏板车已经抢占了市场先机，今年1~8月份市售率为第一。 但如果再有一款车要颜值有颜值、要配置有配置、技术还先进，性能更强悍，各位又该如何应对呢？ 它就是五羊本田刚刚发布的NWZ150 。该车凭借全新的外观在初次亮相时，就被车友们贴上了“小佛沙”的标签，因而很多小伙伴就盼着它早日登场，而现在它来了！ 五羊本田NWZ150起步售价17580元 ，有燃油和轻混两个版本。它的定位和前几款车型都不一样，属于旗舰级车型，所以这款车并不只是外观出众，拥有了大绵羊气场那么简单，它的内核设定同样出彩。 颜值在线·气场全开 五羊本田NWZ150的前脸面积，相较于以往150踏板车会大很多，并融入了前移的后视镜、星空灯组、运动化造型，再加之动感的车身线条、就使得颜值非常在线，有着秒杀竞品的气场。 如果你不去刻意对比，会误把这款车当成是大踏板。因而我愿意将其称之为150踏板车中颜值担当，小踏板中的大绵羊，在观感这一块很容易会成为同级大当家。 满配出道·同级少有 现如今大多数150踏板车的配置组合主要集中在了TFT仪表、无钥匙启动、双通道ABS、 TCS、胎压监测等常规项目，但NWZ150除了以上搭配，还实现了再次晋级。 如堪比350大踏板的电动无级可调风挡、7寸TFT触控屏仪表、前后双摄像头行车记录仪、转向辅助影像、语音交互、2.0Wi LINK、毫米波雷达、加热手把、多种解锁启动等都有应用，属于满配出道，同级少有。 据悉，NWZ150所采用的这块仪表，相比上代在信息处理方面会更加强悍，下达指令后的反馈也会更加高效，所以就能实现更多功能，让触控更流畅。 技术升级·轻混引擎 NWZ150轻混版最大的看点，主要还是集中在了，依托eW15和全新技术应用而来的轻混引擎（最大功率13.2KW，最大扭矩17牛米），简单来说就是融入了电动助力功能，但它要比市面上常见车型先进很多。电池组来到了48V锂电，进而就能实现快人一步的加速表现。 此外，这套系统还有不同的动力档位，可以根据个人的骑行习惯以及路况进行选择，并支持制动力回收、发电制动等多种工况。 总之，五羊本田所打造的这款NWZ150，有颠覆现有车型的意思，它不仅拥有越级的颜值和配置，还实现了电控单元的高度集成化，以及轻混引擎的性能最大化，所以这是一款很值得抢先感受的车型。如此看来实力玩家就是不一样，总能找到突破口，给用户带来惊喜和清晰的选择方向。 点击展开剩下 0 % 打开汽车之家App 阅读体验更佳 作者声明： 个人观点仅供参考 举报/纠错 打开汽车之家App 查看全部评论 相关阅读 数据加载中... 发条有爱评论~ 评论 点赞 收藏 分享 2026-11-23 14:37:13 2026/11/23 15:06:15

records.title: 高田气囊威胁驾驶员，本田-丰田召回160万辆汽车
records.excerpt: 高田气囊威胁驾驶员，本田-丰田召回160万辆汽车 | IDNFinancials 中文 English Indonesian 日本語 العربية 中文 한국어 Français Deutsch Nederlands Español Русский 登录 登录 主页 公司 新闻 数字资产 视频 工具 市场指引 债券赎回 人物 董事关系网 外国净额 持股监测 1%+ 外汇汇率 商业信息 定价 选择语言! 中文 English Indonesian 日本語 العربية 中文 한국어 Français Deutsch Nederlands Español Русский IDR / USD: ---- 截至: 高田气囊威胁驾驶员，本田-丰田召回160万辆汽车 DH LM Ramdhani Pratama, Lisa Monica 22 November 2026, 11:00 WIB DH Ramdhani Pratama 记者 LM Lisa Monica 记者 WhatsApp频道 气囊充气泵破裂的风险促使本田和丰田在美国召回160万辆汽车。 雅加达 - 汽车制造商本田和丰田在美国召回了约160万辆轿车、卡车和SUV，原因是高田气囊充气泵存在破裂风险。 两家制造商要求受影响的车主更换该部件，以防止潜在的伤害。 据路透社报道 ，本田和丰田表示，他们尚未收到与本次最新召回车辆相关的事故或伤害报告。 两家公司还确认，在召回计划中的车辆中，尚未发生气囊充气泵破裂的案例。 另请阅读: MSCI 开启印尼不降级可能性，外资流出能否缓解？ 尽管如此，两家公司将作为预防措施更换受影响车辆中的气囊充气泵。 美国国家公路交通安全管理局（NHTSA）表示，独立测试小组对充气泵劣化进行的分析和模拟，使制造商能够在风险扩大之前采取行动。 NHTSA表示：“本田和丰田看到了某些车辆存在劣化风险的初步证据，目前正在主动进行车辆召回。” NHTSA补充说，其他汽车制造商仍在继续对其气囊充气泵进行分析和测试。 此次召回包括810,592辆在美国的旧款本田轿车和SUV，以及全球790,000辆丰田汽车，其中314,000辆在美国。 对于丰田，受影响的车型包括2002-2010年生产的雷克萨斯SC430、2011年生产的IS250、2017年生产的GX460、2003-2008年生产的丰田卡罗拉、2005-2006年生产的坦途、2005-2007年生产的红杉以及2016-2017年生产的4Runner。 同时，本田的召回包括2013年生产的部分雅阁车型、2012-2013年生产的思域、2012-2013年生产的CR-V、2013年生产的讴歌ILX和2013年生产的讴歌RDX。 本田的召回计划适用于在美国14个州或地区首次销售或注册的车辆。 气囊风险造成人员伤亡 高田气囊充气泵问题已成为美国历史上最大的汽车安全丑闻之一。自2009年以来，该国至少有28人因高田气囊充气泵故障死亡，400多人受伤。 所有这些死亡案例都涉及不含干燥剂的气囊充气泵。至少有20名受害者乘坐的是本田汽车。 与之前的案例不同，本次最新召回计划中的车辆使用的是带有吸湿材料的气囊充气泵。 尽管如此，本田在长期监测和分析后发现，在某些地理区域的某些充气泵中，推进剂材料存在劣化迹象。 丰田也警告称，推进剂材料的劣化可能导致气囊展开时充气泵破裂。 在过去十年中，全球约有24家汽车制造商召回了超过1亿辆使用高田气囊充气泵的车辆。其中约6700万辆在美国。 充气泵故障可能导致气囊展开时气囊管爆炸，并将金属碎片散布到车厢内。 在某些情况下，该部件已导致驾驶员和乘客死亡或受伤。 澳大利亚也发生了类似问题。雷克萨斯已召回7,000多辆汽车，原因是担心高田气囊充气泵的劣化。 此次召回包括2005-2012年生产的部分雷克萨斯IS250、IS250C、IS350和IS-F车型。 截至目前，尚未确定澳大利亚的其他车辆是否受到本次全球最新召回计划的影响。 列入召回名单的车主可以通过澳大利亚政府的车辆召回官方网站查询车辆状态或联系相关制造商。 授权经销商提供的维修服务，包括更换有问题的气囊，对车主免费。(DH) 本文使用AI从印尼语翻译而成。 添加 作为Google上的首选来源 另请阅读 美国国债价格下跌，10年期收益率上升3个基点 持股监测 1%+ 轻松监测上市公司中持股1%以上的股东。 点击这里 本田 丰田 高田 汽车 气囊 分享: 最新消息 # 热门话题 美国 股票 中国 印度尼西亚 指数 人工智能 利率 美联储 Nvidia 数字资产 热门新闻 美国批准向中国出口87.9万枚英伟达和AMD人工智能芯片 20 Nov 2026 18:00 Samuel Sekuritas否认操纵RLCO股票及非法交易 17 Nov 2026 10:00 特朗普会见习近平前夕，收紧对AI芯片出口的监管 17 Nov 2026 12:20 切布PPSDM Migas炼油厂爆炸，ESDM正在调查原因 19 Nov 2026 17:20 美元创19个月新高，美联储加息预期升温 17 Nov 2026 11:20 SEC调查英伟达潜在会计问题，股价暴跌13% 21 Nov 2026 10:00 胡塞武装袭击利雅得金融区，沙特主权财富基金总部受损 19 Nov 2026 20:20 Franky Widjaja 离开金光农业资源与技术，由 David Fernando Audy 接任 18 Nov 2026 12:00 道琼斯指数和纳斯达克指数暴跌，英伟达成为投资者焦点 18 Nov 2026 05:50 中国股市回购未能有效遏制市场下跌 17 Nov 2026 19:40

records.title: 高田安全气囊存破裂风险 丰田和本田在美召回逾112万辆汽车
records.excerpt: 日本汽车制造商丰田（TOYOTA）和本田（HONDA），在美国召回超过112万辆汽车，因为这些车辆安装的高田安全气囊充气装置可能破裂，导致金属碎片飞出，伤及车内人员。路透社报道，丰田召回超过31万4千辆汽车，涉及2002年到2017年生产的部分丰田和立胜（Lexus）车型。本田则召回超过81万辆汽车，涉及2012年和2013年的部分本田和阿库拉（Acura）车型。两家公司表示，目前没有接获这批车辆的安全气囊充气装置破裂的报告。不过，充气装置长期暴露在高温潮湿环境下，内部化学物质可能逐渐变质，增加破裂风险。高田安全气囊的缺陷，自2009年以来已在美国造成至少28人死亡，并引发美国历来最大规模的汽车召回行动。全球至今已有超过一亿辆汽车因相关问题被召回。 高田安全气囊存破裂风险 丰田和本田在美召回逾112万辆汽车 国际 发布 : 21 Nov 2026 08:32 更新 : 21 Nov 2026 08:35 Set 8world as your preferred source on Google 点选设定，提升 Google搜索功能。 安全气囊。（图：路透社） 新功能! 听新闻，按这里! 我要听，按这里! records.title: F1 Las Vegas Grand Prix results changed as FIA announce post-race penalties
records.excerpt: One of the most unusual races in recent years took place but there was no unusual winner as Max Verstappen showed supreme class to take victory at the Las Vegas Grand Prix. Photo: © IMAGO Change your timezone: Las Vegas Grand Prix F1 Las Vegas Grand Prix results changed as FIA announce post-race penalties The final results from the Nevada Strip Dan Ripley Global Editor Professional F1 journalist and analyst Sunday 22 November 2026 15:57 Make us your Google favorite One of the most unusual races in recent years took place but there was no unusual winner as Max Verstappen showed supreme class to take victory at the Las Vegas Grand Prix. In a race that never settled down into any particular race order, the likes of Lando Norris , Oscar Piastri, Kimi Antonelli, George Russell , Isack Hadjar and even Alpine's Pierre Gasly all spent time in the top three before ultimately it was the McLaren drivers led by the 2025 world champion following Verstappen onto the podium. Antonelli and Gasly took fourth and fifth, with the latter's team-mate Franco Colapinto taking sixth to score big points for Alpine. Article continues under video Lewis Hamilton battled back from a 10-second penalty to finish seventh, with Carlos Sainz pipping Russell on the line to finish eighth. Having finished seventh on the road, a 10-second penalty for a clumsy tap on his team-mate Hamilton meant Charles Leclerc was demoted to the final points paying position in 10th. There was also a late penalty handed out to Hadjar, who was penalised for driving too slowly under the safety car , although this had no major impact on his result dropping him one place below Liam Lawson's Racing Bull to finish 15th. Here are the final classified results from the Las Vegas Grand Prix. F1 HEADLINES: Hamilton vs Leclerc boils over AGAIN as Ferrari collision causes bizarre crash F1 Results: Las Vegas Grand Prix Las Vegas Grand Prix Race Results Pos Driver Team Gap 1 Max Verstappen Red Bull 1:27:39.624 2 Lando Norris McLaren +0.639s 3 Oscar Piastri McLaren +1.529s 4 Kimi Antonelli Mercedes +2.574s 5 Pierre Gasly Alpine +2.927s 6 Franco Colapinto Alpine +7.955s 7 Lewis Hamilton Ferrari +12.795s 8 Carlos Sainz Williams +12.938s 9 George Russell Mercedes +13.192s 10 * Charles Leclerc Ferrari +17.554s 11 Nico Hulkenberg Audi +22.720s 12 Gabriel Bortoleto Audi +28.602s 13 Ollie Bearman Haas +28.843s 14 Liam Lawson Racing Bulls +36.588s 15 *Isack Hadjar Red Bull +46.488s 16 Rafael Camara Haas +47.814s 17 Lance Stroll Aston Martin +68.353s 18 Valtteri Bottas Cadillac +71.673s 19 Fernando Alonso Aston Martin DNF NC Arvid Lindblad Racing Bulls DNF NC Sergio Perez Cadillac DNF NC Alex Albon Williams DNS * Charles Leclerc penalised 10 seconds for causing a collision * Isack Hadjar penalised 10 seconds for driving unnecessarily slowly When is the next F1 race? There are only two more F1 races left in the 2026 season and they are coming at you fast! One week after the Vegas action F1 heads to the Qatar Grand Prix for the penultimate round on November 29. It's a race where if Ferrari's drivers don't keep crashing into each other, they will clinch second in the constructors' championship . In a similar vane, despite not being in the title battle for the entire season, Verstappen can also secure runner-up in the championship for the second season running. records.excerpt: FIA confirms Isack Hadjar punishment after ‘deliberate’ Las Vegas GP incident Jamie Woodhouse 22 Nov 2026 10:24 AM Isack Hadjar received a 10-second penalty after the Las Vegas GP Isack Hadjar has received a 10-second time penalty for what the stewards called a “deliberate” and “tactical” act at the Las Vegas Grand Prix. The incident in question occurred under Safety Car conditions, as the stewards determined the Red Bull driver deliberately slowed, under instruction from the team, to create a double stack pit-stop opportunity. FIA stewards explain Isack Hadjar 10-second penalty The Safety Car was deployed on Lap 19 as Cadillac’s Sergio Perez tangled with Rafael Camara in the Haas. Perez tried to pass the Brazilian up the inside into Turn 14, but Camara turned in and a collision followed for which the Cadillac driver was penalised . A flurry of pit-lane activity commenced, and Hadjar had backed up the field so that teammate and race leader Max Verstappen could complete his stop before he arrived at the Red Bull pit box. The stewards took a dim view of the Frenchman’s actions and handed out a post-race 10-second penalty. Added to his race time, it drops him to 15th in the final classification. The verdict reads: “The stewards heard from the driver of Car 6 (Isack Hadjar) and his team representative as well as the team representative of Mercedes-AMG Petronas F1 team and reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video, timing, telemetry, team radio and in-car video evidence. “While driving on the straight between Turns 13 and 14 under Safety Car conditions, the driver of Car 6 received repeated instructions from his team stating “five seconds, five seconds, five seconds”. “Following these instructions, Car 6 significantly reduced its speed, at one point travelling approximately 100 km/h slower than Car 3, which was ahead of it. “The stewards determined that this significant reduction in speed was deliberate and intended to create a gap to the car ahead and was not made for safety reasons, thereby allowing the team to perform a double-stack pit stop without Car 6 losing time waiting behind its teammate in the pit lane. “Furthermore, this manoeuvre directly impacted the cars following Car 6, which were forced to reduce their speed accordingly and could not overtake Car 6 due to the restrictions applicable under Safety Car conditions. “The stewards considered that Car 6 was driving unnecessarily slowly for tactical reasons and that such conduct constituted a breach of the applicable regulations. “In reaching their decision, the stewards also took into account the precedent involving Car 4 (Norris) at the 2023 Canadian Grand Prix, where a penalty was imposed for similar conduct. “The stewards imposed a 10-seconds time penalty which is consistent with the 2026 F1 Penalty Guidelines.” Latest Las Vegas GP talking points on PlanetF1.com Max Verstappen slams George Russell with brutal ‘far below my level’ remark Ferrari blasts ‘unacceptable’ Hamilton, Leclerc clash in Las Vegas Hadjar suffered a broken front wing not long after the race restart, forcing him to box his sparking Red Bull for a new one. He came back out in 19th. He had worked his way back up to 14th by the finish, but drops one spot with the penalty applied. records.excerpt: Liam Lawson vents FIA frustration after Las Vegas GP false start Henry Valantine 22 Nov 2026 6:01 PM From a fuel leak to starting a lap down, it was a difficult Saturday night for Liam Lawson. Liam Lawson shared his frustration at both starting the Las Vegas Grand Prix a lap down, and not receiving the chance to claw that lap back sooner under Safety Car conditions. Lawson suffered a pre-race fuel leak which necessitated a pit-lane start in Las Vegas but, despite Racing Bulls having worked in double-quick time to get him into the action, he began a lap behind the rest of the pack. Liam Lawson bemoans ‘so frustrating’ Las Vegas GP unlapping delay The chance for the New Zealander to rejoin the back of the field came after a collision between Sergio Perez and Rafael Camara brought out the Safety Car, and was likely extended by Lawson’s teammate, Arvid Lindblad, pitching his car into an unexpected spin in yellow flag conditions. Having received the instruction to overtake the Safety Car and catch up, however, he passed the whole field and, by the time racing got going again, Lawson still faced a significant deficit to the rest of the field. This ultimately left him unable to make any headway in the race, crossing the line in 15th place, but would later be promoted one place after a 10-second penalty for Isack Hadjar was applied. The 24-year-old thanked his team for having been able to fix his car, but did not hide his frustration at not being able to make his way back up the pack – with Race Control having opted to take four laps before allowing him to unlap himself. “That’s really the big question I think we need to answer, is what we can do in the future to figure it out earlier,” Lawson said of his fuel leak after the race. “We’ve actually had a similar thing happen in Monaco this year, and both times, the guys and girls have done a really, really good job to put the car together and maximise. “For us to go out on track today, have absolutely no issues, and have a really, really fast race car is massively impressive from everybody – I just feel for them that I couldn’t deliver a result because we lost a lap. “The thing is, I got it back, and we actually probably could have still had a really good race, but I don’t know why they they took four laps to release me. I can still slow down for the double yellow zone and follow a delta. “I’m not going to blow through that zone at high speeds, but it just means I can do the whole lap and catch back up. records.excerpt: FIA explains Charles Leclerc punishment after Lewis Hamilton Las Vegas GP incident Jamie Woodhouse 22 Nov 2026 1:32 PM Charles Leclerc received a 10-second penalty after colliding with Lewis Hamilton The FIA stewards considered Charles Leclerc “wholly to blame” for a fresh clash with Ferrari teammate Lewis Hamilton at the Las Vegas Grand Prix. As a result, the stewards hit Leclerc with a 10-second time penalty. He was ultimately classified 10th. Charles Leclerc got 10-second penalty for Lewis Hamilton incident It was only at the prior round in Brazil that Hamilton and Leclerc squashed the beef stemming from their Mexican GP incident. The pair arrived in Sin City as a united front, Leclerc even suggesting that the media had overblown the situation. By Las Vegas Grand Prix Saturday, there were fresh fireworks between the Ferrari drivers. While Mexico City saw neither driver make Turn 4, opening the door for Max Verstappen, this time, there was a collision between the red cars. As Hamilton eyed-up the McLaren of Oscar Piastri, Leclerc mounted an attack of his own on the Brit into Turn 7. His front right clipped the rear left of the sister Ferrari, sending Hamilton spinning. He dropped to 10th. That triggered an investigation from the FIA stewards, the verdict a 10-second penalty for Leclerc, who was deemed to have caused the collision. Their explanation reads: “The stewards reviewed video and in-car video evidence. “Car 16 attempted to overtake Car 44 on the inside at Turn 7. The Stewards noted that Car 16 initiated the overtaking manoeuvre from a considerable distance behind Car 44, attempting to position his car on the inside. “In assessing the incident, the stewards also took into account the FIA Driving Standards Guidelines, in particular the criteria applicable to overtaking manoeuvres on the inside of a corner. “The stewards determined that the front axle of Car 16 was not at least alongside the mirror of Car 44 at the apex of the corner. “The stewards therefore determined that Car 16 had not earned the right to the corner at Turn 7 and was wholly to blame for the resulting collision. “Accordingly, the stewards imposed a 10-second time penalty.” Ferrari team boss Fred Vasseur had already reminded his drivers after Mexico that the team comes first, so was furious with the pair after this latest flashpoint. He called out a “lack of respect” shown by his drivers towards the team and its sponsors. Leclerc was quick to apologise for his role in the incident post-race. “The race didn’t finish well for us, and my mistake was part of that,” he said. “I accept the penalty and we will review what I could have done differently so it doesn’t happen again. “I’m sorry for the team, for everyone in Maranello and for the points we lost today.” More on Ferrari from PlanetF1.com Telemetry reveals full Ferrari impact of Hamilton, Leclerc clash in Las Vegas Lewis Hamilton: Ferrari ‘deserve better’ after latest Charles Leclerc clash Hamilton was ultimately classified P7. Ferrari failed to wrap-up second in the Constructors’ standings in Las Vegas, but with Red Bull 77 points behind, and a maximum of 86 still up for grabs, P2 is almost certain to go Ferrari’s way. records.excerpt: FIA announces grid penalty for Las Vegas Grand Prix collision Henry Valantine 22 Nov 2026 8:13 AM Sergio Perez retired from the Las Vegas Grand Prix after contact with Rafael Camara. The FIA stewards have decided upon a five-place grid penalty for Sergio Perez for causing a collision with Haas ’ Rafael Camara at the Las Vegas Grand Prix. The Cadillac driver attempted a move into Turn 14, but tagged the rear of the rookie’s car and sent him into a spin, bringing out the Safety Car. FIA stewards confirm Sergio Perez grid penalty Perez had been catching Camara along the Las Vegas Strip Straight, and moved to the inside ahead of the left-right-left sequence of Turns 14-16, but made contact with the Brazilian while doing so. While a 10-second time penalty would normally have been the punishment for such a moment, because Perez retired from the race as a result of the collision, that has been converted to a five-place grid penalty for the Qatar Grand Prix instead. “The Stewards noted that at no point during the manoeuvre was the front axle of Car 11 [Perez] at least alongside the mirror of Car 51 [Camara],” the verdict explained. “The two cars collided at the entry to Turn 14, resulting in Car 11 retiring from the Race. Applying the Driving Standards Guidelines, the Stewards determined that Car 11 had not earned the right to the corner and was wholly to blame for the collision.” Perez attributed some of the blame to the overtake mode capabilities placed on the 2026 cars, with the slipstream effect exaggerated to its fullest extent at the Las Vegas Grand Prix. With that, he did not think Camara would have seen him coming or been expecting a move, because of how far behind Perez was heading onto the Strip. More from the Las Vegas Grand Prix Max Verstappen survives Mercedes onslaught in spectacular Las Vegas Grand Prix thriller Max Verstappen pokes fun at George Russell in Las Vegas GP team radio “It’s this overtake mode, it’s so artificial that basically I exited Turn 12 a second away from Camara, so Camara thought he was completely safe, but then into Turn 14 I was alongside him,” the Cadillac driver explained. “But, when I saw that he was doing a normal line, I tried to avoid him, and it was just too late.” Camara admitted he thought his race was done as a result of being spun around, though he eventually recovered onto the road to take 16th place at the line. “I thought it was over there,” he said. “I don’t know how it didn’t damage anything because we came back and it was all right. We just had to change tyres and came back into it. “I think I was quite surprised with that, and after that we had some fun in the restart, and then after was just a bit more boring being alone.” Read next: Lewis Hamilton fumes at Las Vegas penalty as Charles Leclerc comparison emerges

records.excerpt: Las Vegas Grand Prix 2026 – F1 race results (Las Vegas Strip circuit) Sam Hall 22 Nov 2026 5:55 AM Here are the complete F1 results from race day at the Las Vegas Grand Prix, the 21st round of the F1 2026 season. Max Verstappen won a thrilling race on the iconic Las Vegas streets. F1 results: Las Vegas Grand Prix 2026 Verstappen put on a defensive masterclass in Las Vegas as he saw off threats from Red Bull teammate Isack Hadjar, Mercedes pair George Russell and Kimi Antonelli, and outgoing champion Lando Norris. The race became a battle of deployment, with divisive yo-yo racing in evidence throughout, as drivers passed along The Strip before being repassed on the shorter run to the last corner. Ferrari provided action in the midfield with both Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc picking up 10-second penalties – the latter for colliding with his teammate. Russell had been the chief rival to Verstappen for much of the race, but found himself behind Antonelli in the last 10 laps. Desperate to regain his position, Russell made a lunge down the inside of Turn 5, but locked up and slid into the wall. records.excerpt: FIA confirms double Las Vegas Grand Prix punishment after investigations FIA confirms double Las Vegas Grand Prix punishment after investigations Oliver Harden 21 Nov 2026 8:44 AM Arvid Lindblad (Racing Bulls VCARB03) in action at the 2026 Las Vegas Grand Prix The Racing Bulls team has been fined €5,000 following an unsafe release with Arvid Lindblad ’s car in qualifying at the Las Vegas Grand Prix. Lindblad’s car was released into the path of Alex Albon, who was earlier reprimanded for driving erratically in a near miss with Isack Hadjar in FP3. FIA confirms Racing Bulls, Alex Albon decisions at Las Vegas Grand Prix Lindblad and Albon qualified sixth and 16th respectively on Friday night in Las Vegas. Lindblad was summoned to the stewards after the Racing Bulls team released him into the path of Albon’s car during Q2 in Las Vegas. That came after Albon found himself under investigation following a near miss with Hadjar’s Red Bull in final practice. Following investigations, the stewards confirmed a €5,000 fine for Racing Bulls, with Albon given a driving-related reprimand for the incident in FP3. The stewards’ verdict on Lindblad read: “The Stewards heard from the team representative and reviewed video and in-car video evidence. “Car 41 (LIN) was released from its pit position into the path of Car 23 (ALB), which was approaching in the fast lane. The Stewards determined that this constituted an unsafe release. “During the hearing, the team representative acknowledged that the release was unsafe and explained that a malfunction of the radio communication system had affected the coordination of the release procedure. “The Stewards accepted this explanation and acknowledged that the communication failure was not intentional. “However, the circumstances leading to the release do not alter the fact that Car 41 was released into the path of another car. “The Stewards noted that reliable communication is an important element of a safe release procedure and that appropriate backup arrangements should be available in the event of a communication failure.” Arvid Lindblad vs Liam Lawson: Racing Bulls head-to-head stats for F1 2026 season F1 2026: Head-to-head qualifying statistics between teammates F1 2026: Head-to-head race statistics between teammates The report on Albon read: “The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 23 (Alexander Albon), team representative and reviewed video, timing, telemetry, team radio and in-car video evidence. “Both cars were approaching Turn 17, with Car 23 (ALB) ahead of Car 6 (HAD). “Car 23 was weaving to try keeping temperature in the tyres and preparing for his next flying lap. Car 6 approached from behind at a significantly higher speed, with a speed differential of approximately 60 km/h. “As the cars approached Turn 17, Car 23 moved towards the inside of the corner to take his normal racing line, but into the path of Car 6. The driver of Car 6 had to brake heavily to avoid a collision. “The driver of Car 23 explained that he was preparing for his next flying lap and needed to maintain tyre temperature while also managing his battery status. “He stated that he had not expected Car 6 to close so quickly. “The Stewards considered the movements of Car 23, the significant speed differential between the two cars and the need for Car 6 to take evasive action. “In particular, the Stewards examined whether the driving of Car 23 was unpredictable or potentially dangerous, taking into account the circumstances of his preparation for the following lap. “The Stewards acknowledged that weaving to maintain tyre temperature is common when preparing for a flying lap. However, drivers must remain aware of approaching traffic and ensure that their movements do not create potentially dangerous situations. “In this case, Car 23 moved towards the inside of Turn 17 while Car 6 was approaching at a significantly higher speed, forcing the driver of Car 6 to brake heavily to avoid contact. “The Stewards considered this movement to be unpredictable and potentially dangerous, irrespective of the driver’s intention to prepare for his next flying lap. “The Stewards therefore determined that the driving of Car 23 constituted erratic driving and imposed a driving reprimand.” Read next: George Russell reignites Verstappen war of words after ‘screwing me over’

records.excerpt: Ferrari have launched another inquest after another Lewis Hamilton-Charles Leclerc meltdown - this time at the Las Vegas Grand Prix. Photo: © IMAGO Change your timezone: Las Vegas Grand Prix Ferrari launch Lewis Hamilton vs Charles Leclerc investigation after Las Vegas GP collision More disaster for the Scuderia Graham Shaw Consultant Editor Digital sports specialist running global brands for 30 years Sunday 22 November 2026 08:30 Updated: 08:55 Make us your Google favorite Ferrari have launched another inquest after another Lewis Hamilton - Charles Leclerc meltdown - this time at the Las Vegas Grand Prix. The two Maranello superstar fought long and hard all night on the famous Strip after starting P10 and P11 on the grid. Hamilton himself was handed a 10-second time penalty early in the race after leaving the track while defending against McLaren 's Lando Norris , and Leclerc. Article continues under video It was later in the evening that things really went south for the Scuderia, as Leclerc dived down the inside on Lap 38 in a bid to overtake Hamilton for P7 . Instead he collided with the seven-time world champion, spinning him around. This time it was Leclerc getting a 10-second time penalty, which relegated him to a final finishing position of 10th while Hamilton was three places ahead. It was a bitter pill to swallow for Ferrari team principal Fred Vasseur , having brokered crisis talks following clashes involving Hamilton and Leclerc after the recent Mexican Grand Prix. F1 HEADLINES: Hamilton vs Leclerc boils over AGAIN as Ferrari collision causes bizarre crash Vasseur says Ferrari clash was 'completely unacceptable' Immediately Saturday night's race had ended, the Frenchman was straight on team radio to tell Leclerc: "Charles, I want to see you just after the race, before everything". Later he gave a fuller debrief to media as he fumed: "Clearly it's unacceptable, little bit the same message at Mexico. You think about the team, the people working in Maranello, about all the stakeholders and the sponsors. "We passed the message to Charles, not to not overtake because in this kind of race you have to overtake the cars in front of you or you are passed by the other. You have to do your race. "Charles did clearly a mistake that is penalising the team a lot. It's completely unacceptable today - honestly, I'm more than upset because that message was clear after Mexico. "We had a chat all together in Brazil, today we passed the message to think about the team when they were racing together - and the outcome is this one. It's mega frustrating for all of us." Now Vasseur is not ruling out sanctions for Saturday night's incident, telling Gazzetta dello Sport: "Tomorrow we will discuss the consequences of what happened today, but we will certainly have to take measures, decisions. We won't do that tonight; we must remain calm and then take action. "But it is totally unacceptable that so much effort and resources are being put into all of this and that the work of two thousand people can be ruined in this way." Vasseur says he did not expect these issues when Ferrari signed Hamilton to pair him with Leclerc at Maranello. "Honestly, no. If I had known before, things would have been different," he explained. "The pressure is certainly mounting, and now the situation is much worse than it was 18 months ago. Lately, it's become unmanageable between them. "I think there's a misunderstanding on a human level between the two drivers, not between them and the team. First and foremost, they should respect each other, but they also have to respect the team." Hamilton exasperated by latest Leclerc clash Hamilton was clearly exasperated by what happened on Saturday night as he said: “I’m not gonna get into the scenario, that’s something for you to speak to Ferrari about. “We knew that we faced a massive challenge this weekend - we didn’t realise there was going to be such limitation on the straights. Qualifying obviously was difficult. “But in the race I felt great and I really was progressing well, trying to finish ahead of the McLarens because that’s who we’re really fighting in the Constructors'. “And then avoiding collision with one of the McLarens cost me a 10-second penalty, which I think was really harsh. Which was frustrating. Hamilton was exasperated after latest Leclerc clash. “But I just got my head down and kept chasing, managed to get back in the fight, and then again got knocked back again. But I never gave up, I was trying to get the best results and I really think we could have had a podium today with the pace we had." When asked if it was time for Ferrari to finally implement clear rules to their drivers, Hamilton responded: “That’s for Ferrari to decide obviously. I’ve done all I can, I’ve said everything and more. It’s been difficult. “All I can do is show up and do everything I can and hopefully in the background they eventually figure it out.” Leclerc 'embarrassed for the team' A clearly frustrated Leclerc meanwhile admitted: “I’ve been penalised, so I guess the majority in the stewards thought it was my mistake - I’ll accept that. “I’m not gonna say much more, at the end of the day I’m penalised, so has to be my mistake. “I just felt quite embarrassed for the team in general - I will review.” LAS VEGAS GP RESULTS: Final positions, times and race report READ MORE: FIA announce Charles Leclerc penalty verdict after Lewis Hamilton clash at Las Vegas Grand Prix READ MORE: FIA announce Lewis Hamilton penalty verdict at Las Vegas Grand Prix Written by Graham Shaw - Consultant Editor Digital sports leader with 30 years of senior level experience running global brands. records.title: Telemetry reveals full Ferrari impact of Hamilton, Leclerc clash in Las Vegas
records.excerpt: Telemetry reveals full Ferrari impact of Hamilton, Leclerc clash in Las Vegas Uros Radovanovic 22 Nov 2026 9:22 AM Another clash between Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc cost Ferrari dearly in Las Vegas. Just a few laps before their collision in Las Vegas, Lewis Hamilton was 2.5 seconds behind the race leader and Charles Leclerc 2.9 seconds adrift, with Ferrari the fastest car on track. Telemetry data reveals how much pace the team had in hand, and how a Lap 38 clash left them with just seven points from a race they could have turned into a double podium – and possibly more. How Far Could Ferrari Have Gone in Las Vegas? As discussed after qualifying , Las Vegas combines the worst possible circuit characteristics for the SF-26. The cold track surface amplifies tyre warm-up struggles, preventing Ferrari from matching its usual cornering competitiveness, while the long straights ruthlessly expose its power unit deficit and lower ERS efficiency. During qualifying, that lack of straight-line speed along the Strip wasn’t an issue, as Ferrari adjusted its deployment strategy to remain competitive there and avoid becoming sitting ducks in the race. However, it paid a heavy price for that compromise in the middle sector. Long runs in FP3 revealed that, while Ferrari trailed the leaders on race pace, roughly 70 percent of that deficit originated specifically in Sector 2. Going into Sunday with low expectations, the race nonetheless unfolded very differently. The Grand Prix was both unusual and thrilling to watch: after 10 laps, the top 10 runners sat within five seconds of the race leader—a rare sight in modern Formula 1. Ferrari remained firmly in that lead pack, with both drivers showing solid pace during the opening stint. Starting from P11, one spot behind Leclerc, Hamilton overtook his teammate on the opening lap and climbed as high as P6 at one stage, before settling into P7 and P8 around Lap 15 to battle Norris and Piastri for position. The graph below illustrates average lap times across the opening stint: Antonelli and Piastri set the pace on track, yet everyone else—aside from Norris, who dropped several places—remained closely matched. George Russell, Hamilton and Max Verstappen were on nearly the same race pace for the first 17 laps of the race. Laptimes scatterplot – Race First stint comparison A Lap 19 Safety Car effectively ended any strategic variation: everyone switched from softs to mediums or vice versa, locking in their compounds to the chequered flag. At the Lap 26 restart, Leclerc held seventh, while Hamilton dropped back to P13 after serving a 10-second time penalty and pitting a lap later than the bulk of the field. On the medium compound, however, Ferrari’s pace looked even stronger than in the first stint. Hamilton drove brilliantly, climbing from P13 to P8 in just six laps, while Leclerc gained a spot to sit in P6, with Piastri sandwiched between the two scarlet machines. That triggered the intra-team fight that ultimately ended in contact between Hamilton and Leclerc. Piastri moved ahead of both red cars, while Hamilton pulled off a crisp move around the outside of Turn 3 to repass his teammate. Crucially, a few laps before the collision, Hamilton trailed race leader Verstappen by only 2.5 seconds, with Leclerc just 2.9 seconds adrift; both drivers remained firmly in the fight and, with overtaking happening throughout the field, anything was possible. Then came Lap 38: Hamilton attempted a pass down the inside of Piastri on entry to Turn 5 but failed to complete it, slightly compromising his corner exit—an opening Leclerc immediately tried to exploit. On entry to Turn 7, Charles dived up the inside, resulting in contact that left Hamilton spun around facing the wrong way. Hamilton was ahead at the apex and owned the corner, a verdict confirmed by the stewards, who handed the Monegasque driver a 10-second penalty as his teammate plummeted down the order. Data underscores just how rapid Hamilton was during those opening laps of the second stint: he averaged the fastest pace of any front-running driver, as shown in the graph below – more than four tenths of a second per lap faster than Verstappen on average. Naturally, that delta would have narrowed by the finish, but the takeaway is clear: Ferrari possessed the raw pace to take the fight to McLaren, and possibly Verstappen. Laptimes scatterplot – Race Second stint comparison (from lap 27 to lap 38) More on Ferrari at the Las Vegas Grand Prix Lewis Hamilton fumes at Las Vegas penalty as Charles Leclerc comparison emerges Ferrari summons Charles Leclerc after ‘unacceptable’ Lewis Hamilton Las Vegas clash Had contact been avoided and Ferrari managed to beat McLaren—a thoroughly realistic prospect—we might now be talking about a remarkable Scuderia comeback and a double podium. That outcome would have been aided further by Russell hitting the wall late on and Antonelli losing battery deployment over the final two laps. Instead, we are once again analysing how Ferrari shot itself in the foot and left Las Vegas with just seven points—its second-lowest points haul of the season after scoring only six in Brazil. Whether the team will introduce stricter internal rules of engagement remains to be seen, but one thing is certain: the lack of clear team orders has only hurt it this season. records.excerpt: George Russell reignites Verstappen war of words as FIA takes action George Russell reignites Verstappen war of words after ‘screwing me over’ Oliver Harden 21 Nov 2026 6:49 AM George Russell and Max Verstappen have a long-running rivalry Mercedes driver George Russell has accused Max Verstappen of “screwing me over” after the Red Bull driver was warned by the FIA stewards following a clash between the pair in FP3 at the Las Vegas Grand Prix. And Russell believes “somebody’s got to stand up to that guy”, accusing other drivers of being too accepting of Verstappen’s aggressive tactics. George Russell on Max Verstappen: ‘Somebody’s got to stand up to that guy’ Verstappen was hit with a warning by the stewards following an incident with Russell in the closing stages of final practice. The Red Bull driver passed Russell in the queue ahead of a push lap before braking early and moving across the circuit. Russell responded by diving down Verstappen’s inside at Turn 14, the left-hander at the end of the long back straight, with the pair making contact. Verstappen managed to avoid a grid-place penalty for his role in the incident, escaping with a warning. George Russell vs Kimi Antonelli: Mercedes head-to-head stats for F1 2026 season F1 2026: Head-to-head qualifying statistics between teammates F1 2026: Head-to-head race statistics between teammates Verstappen and Russell went on to qualify second and third respectively as F1 2026 world champion Kimi Antonelli set the fastest time. With Antonelli serving a five-place grid penalty for an engine change, Verstappen will start Saturday night’s race from pole position with Russell alongside him on the front row. Speaking to Sky Italia after qualifying, Russell accused Verstappen of “screwing” his rivals over race after race by jumping the queue before starting a flying lap. And he vowed to stand up to Verstappen, who he says believes he is “bigger and better than everyone else.” Asked about the FIA’s decision on Verstappen, Russell said: “I think a warning was fine. “There’s nothing in the rules to say you cannot overtake someone who is starting a lap, but when you do this you are screwing this person over and he does this week in, week out with many drivers and everybody accepts it. “I’m not just going to accept somebody to screw me over like this and walk around like they’re bigger and better than everyone else. “Somebody’s got to stand up to that guy.” More on George Russell and Max Verstappen from PlanetF1.com George Russell news Max Verstappen news Russell’s comments are the latest in a long-running war of words with Verstappen, who memorably clashed on the opening lap of the 2023 Azerbaijan Grand Prix sprint race. The pair were involved in an entertaining back and forth at the end of the 2024 season, when Verstappen accused Russell of exaggerating an incident in an attempt to get him penalised in Qatar. At the season finale in Abu Dhabi a week later, Russell claimed that Verstappen had threatened to “purposefully go out of his way to crash into me and put me on my head in the wall.” Russell also added that Verstappen “lashes out with unnecessary anger and borderline violence” when things go against him. records.excerpt: FIA confirms Max Verstappen punishment after George Russell investigation FIA confirms Max Verstappen punishment after George Russell investigation Oliver Harden 21 Nov 2026 5:18 AM Max Verstappen and George Russell: the best of enemies Max Verstappen has been handed a warning by the FIA stewards following an incident with Mercedes driver George Russell in FP3 at the Las Vegas Grand Prix. The Red Bull man will also face no further action following an earlier incident with Alpine’s Franco Colapinto. Max Verstappen warned by FIA stewards after George Russell clash Verstappen and Russell were summoned to the stewards following an incident in final practice at Las Vegas. Verstappen’s Red Bull passed Russell on the back straight and appeared to brake early, with the Mercedes driver making contact with Verstappen as he repassed on the inside of Turn 14. Following an investigation, the stewards have issued Verstappen with a warning. Max Verstappen vs Isack Hadjar: Red Bull head-to-head stats for F1 2026 season F1 2026: Head-to-head qualifying statistics between teammates F1 2026: Head-to-head race statistics between teammates The stewards’ verdict read: “The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 3 (Max Verstappen), the driver of Car 63 (George Russell), team representatives and reviewed video, telemetry, team radio and in-car video evidence. “Both cars were approaching Turn 14, with Car 3 ahead of Car 63. “Car 3 braked earlier than expected and changed direction under braking. Car 63, approaching from behind, moved to the left and attempted to overtake on the inside. “During the manoeuvre, the front axle of Car 63 was ahead of the mirror of Car 3. The two cars subsequently made contact. “During the hearing, the drivers also discussed the informal gentlemen’s agreements concerning the preparation for a flying lap and the conduct expected between drivers in such situations. “The Stewards noted these explanations but considered that such informal understandings were of limited relevance to the assessment of the incident. “The decisive considerations were the actual movements of both cars and their relative positions. “The Stewards therefore examined the braking and change of direction of Car 3, the evasive manoeuvre and positioning of Car 63 and taking into account the applicable Driving Standards Guidelines. “The Stewards considered that Car 3’s change of direction under braking was unpredictable and contributed to the situation in which Car 63 had to move to the inside to avoid contact. “While the Stewards did not consider the manoeuvre sufficiently serious to warrant a more severe penalty, they concluded that changing direction under braking in these circumstances fell below the standard of driving expected. “Taking into account the circumstances of the incident, the Stewards determined that a Driver Warning was appropriate.” More on Max Verstappen and Red Bull Racing from PlanetF1.com Max Verstappen news Red Bull news Verstappen also found himself the subject of a second investigation for driving erratically, having been spotted weaving in front of Colapinto while generating tyre temperature in the early stages of the session. The stewards opted to take no further action for that incident. The verdict read: “The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 3 (Max Verstappen), team representative and reviewed video, telemetry, team radio and in-car video evidence. “Both cars were on out laps approaching the corner, with Car 3 (VER) ahead of Car 43 (COL). “Car 3 was weaving from side to side while Car 43 approached from behind at a slightly higher speed. “As Car 43 completed the overtaking [sic], Car 3 moved toward the the [sic] hand side of the track and Car 43 passed on the left. “The driver of Car 3 explained that he was weaving to warm his tyres up and that he could not use more energy due to issues he had with his engine earlier in the lap. “In contrast, the driver of Car 43 deployed a significant amount of energy which allowed him to overtake Car 3 and caught the driver of Car 3 by surprise. “He stated that he had not expected Car 43 to attempt an overtake because both were on a preparation lap and approaching the last turn. “Once he became aware of the overtaking manoeuvre, he remained on the right-hand side of the track to allow Car 43 to pass without issue. “The Stewards considered the movements (i. e. weaving) of Car 3, the fact that Car 3 experienced some issues with the engine earlier in the lap and that it had an impact on the energy deployment, the fact that both cars were on out laps, the relative speeds of the two cars and the circumstances of the overtaking manoeuvre which was ultimately completed without issue. “The Stewards acknowledged that weaving to maintain tyre temperature is common during the preparation for a flying lap. “In this case, when the driver of Car 3 realised that Car 43 was overtaking, he immediately stopped the weaving and maintained his position on the right-hand side and allowed Car 43 to pass. “Taking into account the issue that lead [sic] to a lack of energy deployment, the relatively small speed differential and the absence of any further movement towards Car 43, the Stewards concluded there were mitigating elements. “The Stewards therefore determined to take no further action.” Read next: Michael Schumacher’s legendary F2004 suffers dramatic crash at Ferrari event Red Bull FIA George Russell records.excerpt: Next weekend's Qatar Grand Prix will see the return of mandatory limits on how long teams can run a single set of tyres. Photo: © IMAGO Change your timezone: Qatar Grand Prix Major limits announced for F1 Qatar Grand Prix over safety concerns Here we go again! Chris Deeley Editor Experienced sports writer covering F1 and other motorsports since 2023 Saturday 21 November 2026 10:57 Make us your Google favorite Next weekend's Qatar Grand Prix will see the return of mandatory limits on how long teams can run a single set of tyres. Pirelli have confirmed that the limit put in place for the 2025 edition of the race will return, although teams will be able to go 27 laps in a row rather than 25, as was the case last season. The limits are being imposed for safety reasons, with the specific layout of the Lusail circuit – lots of medium- and high-speed corners – putting an unusual amount of stress through the front tyres. Article continues under video Those limits will mandate a minimum of two pit stops per driver during the 57-lap race, with no chance of stretching out to a one-stop strategy due to a safety car – with laps run under caution still counting toward the 27-lap limit. READ MORE: Major F1 broadcaster boycotts Qatar Grand Prix as drastic action taken Pirelli chief: Lap limits going up by two in 2026 Dario Marrafuschi, Pirelli’s motorsport director, told the media this week: "We will apply the same restriction as in 2025. The rules remain unchanged, but the maximum number of laps will be 27 instead of 25. So we have increased the limit by two laps. Our indoor tests showed that this is acceptable, without any particular risks." He continued: "On average, tyres reach 100 percent wear after 25 or 26 laps. This puts more stress on the tyre because the rubber layer no longer protects the structure. "On top of that, there are the high loads, significant lateral forces and high temperatures. These factors play a greater role than the tyre’s resistance to internal pressure." 2026 'easier' to study tyres with no sprint race Explaining the situation ahead of the penultimate weekend of the 2026 season, Marrafuschi said: "We know that when the front tyres reach 100 percent wear, this does not necessarily result in a major drop in performance. "Teams can manage the front tyres quite easily during long runs. So it is not the end of the road if they do not see a significant loss of performance." "We count the number of laps in every session," he added. "That will be a little easier this year because it is not a sprint weekend, whereas it was last year. At the end of Saturday, we will check the number of laps completed and announce how many laps remain for each set." records.excerpt: Fernando Alonso laments Aston Martin problem after untelevised radio message Fernando Alonso laments Aston Martin problem after untelevised radio message Sam Hall 21 Nov 2026 10:49 AM Fernando Alonso has revealed the shocking extent of Aston Martin ’s problems in Las Vegas, while pointing the finger of blame squarely at power unit supplier Honda. The Honda power unit has been a severe limiting factor for Aston Martin this year, with Alonso claiming the AMR26 lost up to three seconds of lap time on the straights in Las Vegas. Fernando Alonso makes Honda claim in Las Vegas Aston Martin is in the midst of arguably one of the most underwhelming campaigns in F1 history, with initial statements that the team hoped to be challenging for podiums and race wins, before a torrid year of reliability and performance woes. Dry running for the majority of the year kept people guessing as to whether the Honda power unit was really to blame or the team had got the new aerodynamic regulations drastically wrong. But a major chassis overhaul prior to the summer break and recent wet running, which acts as somewhat of a leveller to any power deficiencies, highlighted exactly where the problems lie. This has been backed up by difficulties experienced on high-speed layouts such as Monza. And even with Honda being granted by far the largest ADUO (Additional Development and Upgrade Opportunities) allowance of any supplier, it is still a long way back on the rest of the field. Alonso qualified in 19th place, ahead of only teammate Lance Stroll, Valtteri Bottas, and Ollie Bearman, who didn’t set a meaningful time. Asked how complicated the session had been, Alonso reflected: “Exactly as expected. “Monza and Vegas are the worst tracks for us, with the longest straights. So, yeah, we lost like 2.5 seconds or three seconds on the straights. On the corners, we were quite competitive, to be honest. I think we were 2.8 from P1 in Q1, and yeah, I think we lose more or less that on the straights.” As for the experience of driving under the iconic lights of The Strip, Alonso’s excitement is more than a little muted. “It is nice, but yeah, obviously we don’t have the same car, so it’s not really a competition or race,” he added. “It’s demo laps for us.” More Las Vegas Grand Prix news from PlanetF1.com Lando Norris rues ‘shocking’ McLaren flaw that thwarted Las Vegas pole bid Charles Leclerc reveals alarming scale of Ferrari engine deficit in Las Vegas This is not the first time that the Spanish veteran has shown his frustration this weekend, after being passed with ease by most every car during second practice, which was run largely on intermediate tyres on a drying track. “Ridiculous, ridiculous,” he said in an untelevised team radio broadcast. “Let me know what is 20 seconds behind me. It is more or less what I am losing on the straight.” Asked if he wanted to continue, as the team was unsure how much more it could learn from the session, Alonso quipped back: “Yeah, we continue; we learn how bad it is.” Read next: Winners and losers from the 2026 Las Vegas Grand Prix Qualifying Aston Martin Fernando Alonso Related Articles Jamie Woodhouse 19 Nov 2026 Fernando Alonso makes F1 V8s announcement as ’16 years pure racing lost’ V8 engines are set to return to Formula 1.
